newsitem.title: USA: Stage Stores unit raises sub notes purchase price.
newsitem.headline: Stage Stores unit raises sub notes purchase price.

text.p: Stage Stores Inc said on Tuesday that its unit, Specialty Retailers Inc, has raised the purchase price of its 11 percent senior subordinated notes due 2003 to a yield to first call of 75 basis points over Treasuries from an original level of 100 basis points over comparable Treasuries.

On May 8, the company began a tender offer and consent solication for its outstanding senior subordinated notes as well as it 10 percent senior notes due 2000. The purchase price of the senior notes has not changed, the company said.
The offer will expire on June 5, 1997.
Calls to James Marcum, Stage Stores chief financial officer, were not immediately returned.
